title: Reflect notes website
lede: A note-taking app shown as a dark, translucent window that a violet light glows through.
summary: A dark glass app window under a violet eclipse glow, with a pill-shaped translucent navigation bar.

evidence.note: Captured with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. Nothing covers the page. A Superdesign article names Reflect as a glassmorphism example; that claim was not relied on.

styles.note: Borderline: the app window is dark translucent glass that the violet glow shows through, but the page is mostly near-black and uses small radii.

observed: The page is near-black navy. A bright violet and white ring of light, like an eclipse, sits behind the top edge of an app window.
The app window is dark and translucent: the violet glow shows through its middle column as a soft haze.
The window has rounded corners and a thin light border. Inside it, a sidebar, a note, and a calendar use grey and white sans-serif text.
The top navigation links sit in one dark pill with a thin border. ‘Start free trial’ is a violet button with a light border.
interpretation: Measured: blur share 0.21, median radius 6 px, 27 % of boxes bordered, and 62 % with gradient fills. It fails five of six metrics, so the glass effect here comes from one large element rather than many cards. It is the dark, glow-lit variant of the style, close to the look of many AI and developer-tool sites.
borrow: Put a single bright glow behind the top edge of a dark glass panel so that the light seems to pass through it.

images.alt: Reflect home page: the headline ‘Think better with Reflect’ above a violet eclipse glow, which shines through a dark translucent app window with a sidebar, a daily note, and a calendar.
